title: Switzerland – Electrical wiring and fitting work – RETROFIT DES CELLULES 6.4 kV DE JOULE PAR DE NOUVELLES CELLULES 24 KV SANS SF6
description: Le présent appel d'offres porte sur le renouvellement complet de l’installation moyenne tension (6,4 kV) du poste de Joule, situé au chemin du Bochet 5 ,1024 Ecublens et la fourniture de 32 nouvelles cellules MT conçues selon une technologie sans SF₆. Le projet s'inscrit dans la stratégie de modernisation du réseau de distribution de SIE SA et constitue une étape majeure de la migration progressive du réseau de distribution de 6,4 kV vers 21 kV. Le projet comprend notamment : * Le démontage, le recyclage et l'évacuation des cellules et matériel MT existantes ; * La démolition et l’évacuation des niches existantes ; * L’évacuation d’une bonbonne d’Azote présente dans le poste ; * L’élimination de 2 barils d’huile (416 l au total) ; * Le remplacement complet des cellules moyenne tension existantes ; * Le renouvellement des services auxiliaires AC et DC et des batteries ainsi que l’amélioration complète des installations CVSE ; * Le renouvellement des équipements de contrôle-commande, de protection et de communication ; * L'intégration des équipements existants conservés ; * Les travaux de génie civil nécessaires ; * Les adaptations des liaisons câblées moyenne tension existantes (optionnelle); * Le transport et montage de l’ensemble des équipements fournis ; * Les essais en usine (FAT), les essais sur site (SAT), les essais fonctionnels ainsi que la mise en service complète des installations ; * La remise de l'ensemble de la documentation conforme à l'exécution. Les nouvelles cellules devront permettre une exploitation dans une première phase sous une tension de 6,4 kV puis, sans modification structurelle des équipements principaux, sous une tension de 21 kV. En conséquent, les transformateurs de tension devront être dimensionnés pour permettre ce changement de tension modifications. Les cellules devront être conçues selon une technologie sans SF₆ et de préférence isolée à l’air et compatible avec les exigences environnementales actuelles et conformes aux prescriptions techniques du présent cahier des charges et des normes en vigueurs. Les équipements haute tension (50kV) existants ainsi que les transformateurs de puissance sont conservés. Le présent marché comprend uniquement les interfaces nécessaires à leur maintien en exploitation.

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Offener Realisierungswettbewerb "Gartenschau 2033" mit Ideenteilen und anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren Objektplanung Freianlagen
description: Die Gemeinde Benningen am Neckar und die Stadt Marbach am Neckar haben sich für die gemeinsame Gartenschau beworben und den Zuschlag für die Ausrichtung der Gartenschau 2033 erhalten. Mit den Daueranlagen, die im Rahmen der Gartenschau entstehen sollen, soll eine ökologische Aufwertung erfolgen, soziale Angebote bzw. Treffpunkte geschaffen und die Verbindung beider Kommunen gestärkt werden. Im Mittelpunkt steht der Neckar als verbindendes Element. Die Neckarauen haben eine hohe ökologische und freiräumliche Bedeutung, die es zu sichern und weiterzuentwickeln gilt. Gleichzeitig sollen neue Aufenthalts- und Erholungsangebote entstehen und vernetzt werden. Dabei ist die bessere fuß- und radläufige Verbindung eine zentrale Aufgabe. Dazu gehört der Brückenschlag als neue Neckarquerung. Ebenso wichtig ist die Überwindung der Höhenunterschiede zwischen den Siedlungsbereichen und den Neckarauen. Die Daueranlagen sollen dauerhaft in die Siedlungsstruktur eingebunden werden. Kulturelle und historische Orte werden gezielt einbezogen und gestärkt. Die Teilräume der Daueranlagen weisen unterschiedliche Qualitäten auf, die herausgearbeitet und weiterentwickelt werden sollen. Naturnahe Bereiche stehen neben siedlungsnahen und kulturell geprägten Räumen. Neue Zugänge und behutsame Gestaltungen sollen bisher wenig erschlossene Orte erlebbar machen. Es werden eigenständige, innovative und identitätsstiftende Konzepte gesucht, die Entwurfsideen entwickeln, die die Bereiche der Daueranlagen neu interpretieren, überraschende Perspektiven eröffnen und eine starke, wiedererkennbare Haltung formulieren. Insgesamt wird ein zusammenhängendes Konzept erwartet, das eine gemeinsame Identität der Daueranlagen schafft und zugleich die Besonderheiten der einzelnen Orte betont. Die Daueranlagen im Realisierungsteil umfassen eine Flächen von rund 21,6 ha.

title: Belgium – Legal services – Marché public ayant pour objet les services juridiques relatifs au contentieux lié au recouvrement des redevances de stationnement de l’Agence du stationnement de la Région de Bruxelles-Capitale
description: Le présent marché est un marché public de services à prester « à la demande expresse » du Pouvoir adjudicateur dans le cadre du recouvrement des redevances forfaitaires de stationnement par les titulaires de plaques d’immatriculation belges, dues à l’Agence en vertu de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022. Le présent marché concerne le contentieux judiciaire lié au recouvrement des redevances de stationnement restées impayées à l’échéance du second rappel, notamment, dans les hypothèses suivantes : - les conditions d’établissement de la contrainte ne sont pas réunies et l’Agence décide de poursuivre le recouvrement par la voie judiciaire (article 16, § 7 de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022) ; l’adjudicataire devra établir la citation destinée à saisir le Tribunal compétent et prester l’ensemble des services nécessaires à l’obtention d’un jugement favorable à l’Agence permettant de récupérer le montant principal et ses accessoires en réduisant au maximum les coûts tant pour le redevable que pour l’Agence ; - un recours a été introduit par un redevable s’opposant à la contrainte établie, visée et signifiée par exploit d’huissier (article 16, § 7 de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022) ; l’adjudicataire devra représenter l’Agence devant le Tribunal saisi par le redevable et prestera l’ensemble des services nécessaires à l’obtention d’un jugement favorable tout en réduisant au maximum les coûts tant pour le redevable que pour l’Agence ; Le pouvoir adjudicateur privilégie, à l’issue de la citation dans les dossiers contradictoires où le débiteur comparaît personnellement ou par l’intermédiaire de son conseil, le recours à la négociation en vue d’un accord amiable, dans le respect des normes applicables et avec pour objectif de limiter au maximum les frais mis à charge des débiteurs ; Le présent marché concerne plusieurs commandes effectuées par le pouvoir adjudicateur en fonction des besoins et suivant les dispositions du présent cahier des charges. Le présent marché ne confère pas d’exclusivité dans le chef des adjudicataires et ne garantit aucune quantité de commande. Le marché est divisé en trois lots suivant le lieu du domicile du redevable : Lot 1 - Recouvrement en Région de Bruxelles-Capitale ; Lot 2 - Recouvrement en Région wallonne ; Lot 3 - Recouvrement en Région flamande. Il est précisé qu’un soumissionnaire ne peut se voir attribuer qu’un seul lot. Si le soumissionnaire dépose une offre pour plus d’un lot – ce qu’il peut faire –, il indique l’ordre de préférence des lots qu’il souhaite se voir attribuer, s’il était l’attributaire potentiel de plusieurs lots. Aucune amélioration/rabais de l’offre ne peut être liée à l’obtention de plusieurs lots. Il se voit attribuer le lot selon l’ordre de préférence indiqué, pour autant qu’il soit l’offrant le plus intéressant pour ledit lot. Si deux offrants sont à égalité dans le cadre de la règle précitée, l’adjudicateur peut leur permettre d’améliorer leur offre de prix. La présente disposition est adoptée en exécution de l’article 58 § 2 de la loi du 17 juin 2016. Le pouvoir adjudicateur se réserve le droit de ne pas négocier.

title: Belgium – Land rental or sale services – Verkoop onder voorwaarden Noordlaan A-plein - Genk tot realisatie van een woonontwikkeling
description: Stad Genk is eigenaar van een projectgebied gelegen aan het voormalige voetbalveld A-plein van KFC Winterslag, ontsloten via de Noordlaan en Brikkenovenstraat. Dit gebied bevindt zich binnen het toepassingsgebied van het BPA Winterslag 41 "Tuinwijk West nr. 41. De opdracht is gekwalificeerd als een overheidsopdracht van diensten voor de opmaak van een inrichtingsplan, de commerciële ontwikkeling van private woonentiteiten, het ontwerpen van de private groenomgeving en de publieke infrastructuur. Het voorwerp van de opdracht is het gunnen van een zakelijk recht (deels eigendomsrecht en deels recht van opstal) op het projectgebied met het oog op het realiseren van een woonontwikkeling. De Stad Genk wenst de gronden en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden aan te bieden aan de markt via een mededingingsprocedure met onderhandeling. Op deze basis wenst de Stad Genk op een objectieve en transparante manier de best voorwaarden voor het projectgebied te kunnen verkrijgen.

title: Forschungsprojekt - DZSF - Mobilitätskettenanalyse - Wie Verkehrsdaten den ländlichen Schienenverkehr stärken können
description: Durch das Projekt sollen Mobilitätsketten im ländlichen Raum mittels einer Methodentriangulation analysiert und dabei insbesondere die Rolle des Schienenpersonenverkehrs (SPV) untersucht werden. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Vergleich und der Verknüpfung von objektiven Verkehrsdaten mit subjektiven Angaben zur Nutzung und Wahrnehmung der verschiedenen Verkehrsmittel. Neben dem Sammeln und Erheben von Daten in ausgewählten Fokusregionen, dienen ergänzende, experimentelle Studien dazu, kausale Aussagen über die Wirksamkeit von Maßnahmen zur Förderung des Nutzens nachhaltiger Mobilitätsketten im ländlichen Raum anstellen zu können.

title: Germany – Central-heating installation work – 040-01 Heizung
description: Die bestehende Heizungsanlage befindet sich im Untergeschoss der Mittelschule und wird am Ende der Umbaumaßnahmen demontiert. Die Demontagearbeiten umfassen einen kellergeschweißten Öltank mit ca. 17.000 Liter Inhalt inkl. der Ölfüll- und Entlüftungsleitungen, dieser befindet sich neben dem Zwischenbau der Verwaltung im Untergeschoss. Des Weiteren muss die Gaskesselanlage ca. 460 kW und die Ölkesselanlage ca. 405 kW fachgerecht außer Betrieb genommen und demontiert werden. Das bestehende Blockheizkraftwerk (BHKW / 80kW thermisch / 50 kW elektrisch) befindet sich im Untergeschoss der Mittelschule und bleibt an dieser Position, dieses wird wieder in die neue Anlage eingebunden. Die neue Heizungsanlage befindet sich im Untergeschoss des Neubaus der Erweiterung der Mittelschule und besteht aus zwei Biomassekesseln mit einer Leistung von jeweils ca. 450 kW. Der Betrieb der Kesselanlagen wird mit Hackgut als auch Pellets ausgeführt, sodass der Bauherr sich beide Optionen offenhält. Die Abgasanlage der beiden Biomasseanlagen ist ebenfalls zu erstellen. Die Bunkeranlage wird mit zwei getrennten Rührwerken (Bunkern) eines für jeden Kessel ausgeführt. Die neu entstehende Heizzentrale mit den genannten Wärmeerzeugern umfasst den Betrieb von mehreren Gebäuden (verschiedene Schul- und nicht Schulgebäude), auch aktuell werden diese angeschlossenen Gebäude durch die Heizzentrale von der Schule Waging versorgt. Die alte Heizungsanlage wird erst demontiert, wenn die neue Heizungsanlage vollständig in Betrieb ist, damit ist ein ständiger Betrieb für die Abnehmer durch den Versorger gewährleistet. Auch die Neubauten der Grundschule, OGTS 1-4, Verwaltungsbau, Erweiterung der Mittelschule OGTS 5-10 mit Aula/Pausenhalle und Speiseraum werden durch die neue Anlage versorgt. In der neuen Technikzentrale befinden sich vier Heizungspufferspeicher mit je 7.000 Liter Volumen, diese müssen eingebracht werden, bevor die Decke über dem Untergeschoss gesetzt wird. Des Weiteren befinden sich in der Technikzentrale die folgenden Bauteile und Materialien wie eine Entgasung/Druckhaltung mit Nachspeisung, Heizungsverteiler thermisch getrennt für 11 Abgänge von DN 40 – DN 125 inkl. Pumpen, Armaturen, Wärmedämmung, Schmutzfänger, Fühler, Einbau von MSR-Mischventilen und Ventile, Thermometer, Strangregulierventile und diverse Bezeichnungsschilder. Die Rohrleitungen mittels Gewinderohr mittelschwer geschweißt von DN 15 – DN 125 + Formstücke, Brandschotts, Bezeichnungsschilder, Entleerungen und Befüllungen sowie Dichtheitsprüfungen und Beprobung des Heizungswassers. Zur Anbindung des Zwischenbaus der Mittelschule Verwaltung von der Heizzentrale aus, wird eine Nahwärmeleitung ins Erdreich verlegt, diese besteht aus zwei Einzelrohren. Die Heizungsseitige (Vor- und Rücklauf zu den Heizregistern) Anbindung von der Heizzentrale zu den fünf Lüftungsgeräten ist ebenfalls herzustellen. Die heizungsseitige Versorgung (Raumheizflächen) der Neubauten wird mittels Fußbodenheizung ausgeführt. Fußbodenheizung mit ca. 24.000 m Systemrohr, ca. 3.500 m² Systemplatte, Randdämmstreifen, keine Tacker/da Klettsystem, ca. 440 Klemmringverschraubungen, Rohrführungsbögen, Schutzhülsen + sonstige Komponente, 21 Heizkreisverteiler und Verteilerschränke von 4 – 14 Heizkreisen, Einregulierung und Beschriften der Heizkreise in den Verteilern (hydraulisch abgleichen), Montage von bauseits gelieferten Stellmotoren, Belegreif-/Funktionsheizen des Estrich in mehreren Bauabschnitten mit einer bereitgestellten und programmierten Regelung zur Ansteuerung der Pumpe, Mischer und Fühler. Weitere projektbezogene Anforderungen sind die Baustelleneinrichtung, fahrbares Gerüst, Stahlkonstruktionen und Befestigungen, Verschließen von Wand- und Deckendurchführungen mit Brandschutzanforderung, Einweisung Personal des Bauherrn, Erstellung von Protokollen wie Dichtheitsprüfung, Analyse Heizungsfüllwasser, Inbetriebnahme. Einbringung der Bauteile über Einbringschacht (außer Pufferspeicher vorab), Erstellen von Bestandsplänen und Bestandsunterlagen, Wartungsleistungen, Hydraulischer Abgleich, Koordinationsleistungen und Schnittstellen der weiteren Gewerke wie MSR, Sanitär, Lüftung, Elektro. Anschluss vom neuen Heizungsverteiler an die bestehenden Abgänge der Abnehmer im Untergeschoss.

title: Norway – Machinery for the treatment of sewage – Purchase of treatment plant for BIR Ressurs - Mjelstad landfill
description: BIR AS on behalf of BIR Ressurs department. Mjelstad (referred to as BIR) shall, in connection with the expansion of the landfill site, procure a new treatment facility for ladder water arising as a result of precipitation at the landfill. BIR shall ensure that the area and building is established where the treatment plant shall be constructed. Tenderers of the treatment plant must be responsible for the complete delivery of treatment facilities with all the accompanying equipment that is necessary for operation, as well as assembly, commissioning and training. This is further described in the tender documentation. It is important for BIR to get sufficient information about the treatment plant in order to facilitate for the correct dimensioned building. BIR shall procure the pumps that shall deliver ladder water to the treatment facility and from the pump sump after the treatment plant to the recipient. It is important that BIR receives information about the interface and sets the dimensions of the treatment plant as the basis for pump capacity.

title: Switzerland – Electrical installation work – Programme de Transition Ecologique - Etat de Genève - CO Drize - Appel d'Offres Consortium d'Entreprises et de Mandataires
description: Dans le cadre de son programme de transition écologique, le département du territoire, et plus particulièrement l’Office cantonal des bâtiments (aussi dénommé ci-après "OCBA") développe plusieurs opérations de transformation de bâtiments cantonaux. Le projet du CO Drize concerne la rénovation complète des installations d’éclairage intérieur et extérieur du bâtiment sis Route de Drize 8 à Carouge. Les études de phase SIA 31, réalisées par AD Engineering, mandataire ingénieur électricien du Maître de l'ouvrage, ont porté sur l’état des installations existantes, le repérage des luminaires, les niveaux d’éclairement, les bilans de puissance, les principes de remplacement, la régulation et l’adaptation de l’automatisme existant. Le dossier de fin de phase 31 a été accepté par le Maître de l’ouvrage et sert de base au développement de la phase SIA 32 (voir « 4 Ingénieur électricien – rapport de fin de phase 31)). La solution retenue prévoit le remplacement d’environ 2’855 luminaires sur 2’873 existants, principalement fluorescents et halogènes, par des luminaires LED. Le projet intègre la régulation DALI, l’ajout ou l’adaptation de détecteurs et la reprogrammation de l’installation KNX existante. Le principe recherché est de conserver autant que possible les infrastructures existantes – circuits, ossatures et faux plafonds – tout en réalisant les adaptations nécessaires à un ouvrage conforme, exploitable et maintenable. Les documents techniques avaient initialement été préparés pour des adjudications séparées par corps de métier. L’OCBA a décidé de confier l’ensemble de l’opération à un consortium de mandataires et d’entreprises, interlocuteur unique responsable de la réalisation complète. Les travaux à réaliser au Cycle d’orientation de Drize (ci-après aussi dénommé "le projet" ou "le marché"), faisant l'objet du présent appel d'offre sont les suivants : · réalisation des études de phase 32 (projet de l'ouvrage) ; · installations de chantier, protections, moyens d’accès et interventions en hauteur ; · dépose des luminaires existants, fourniture, pose et réglage de la nouvelle lustrerie LED ; · installations électriques, éclairage de secours, contrôles OIBT et adaptations des distributions existantes ; · automatismes du bâtiment, adaptation / reprogrammation KNX, DALI, détection et variation selon l’apport de lumière naturelle ; · travaux connexes, assainissement, faux plafonds, plâtrerie, peinture, réfections et nettoyage ; · coordination d’un chantier en établissement scolaire partiellement occupé, réalisé par phases et sur plusieurs années – les travaux se déroulant principalement durant la période des vacances scolaires.

title: Kaupin yliopistollinen sosiaali- ja terveysasema
description: Kaupin yliopistollinen sosiaali- ja terveysasema Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue valmistelee Kaupin yliopistollisen sosiaali- ja terveysaseman uudisrakennushanketta Tampereen yliopistollisen sairaalan Kaupin kampusalueelle. Kaupin yliopistollisen sote-aseman uudisrakennus (uusi C-rakennus) on n. 15 000 brm2:n (urakoinnin laajuus laskenta-asiakirjojen mukaan) laajuinen rakennus, johon sijoitetaan mm. terveysaseman vastaanottopalvelut, aikuisten sekä lasten- ja nuorten mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut, työikäisten sosiaalityö ja perheohjaus, avokuntoutus, suun terveydenhuolto, äitiys- ja lastenneuvola sekä kehitystä tukevat palvelut. Uusi C-rakennus rakennetaan Taysin Kaupin kampukselle nykyisten purettavien TAMKin rakennusten paikalle. Vanhat rakennukset puretaan ennen uudisrakennuksen urakan käynnistymistä. Uusi C-rakennus kytketään tunnelilla sairaala-alueen tunneliverkostoon ja ilmasillalla sairaalakampukseen sekä TAMKin olemassa olevaan ilmasiltaan. Hankkeen urakkamuoto on jaettu urakka. Tällä hankintailmoituksella haetaan hankkeelle rakennusurakoitsijaa, joka toimii hankkeessa myös pääurakoitsijana ja lainsäädännön tarkoittamana päätoteuttajana. Hankkeen sivu-urakoitsijoita (putkiurakkaan, ilmanvaihtourakkaan, sammutusjärjestelmäurakkaan ja sähköurakkaan) haetaan toisella erillisellä hankintailmoituksella. Rakennusautomaatiourakoitsijana tulee toimimaan Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen puitesopimuskumppani. Tarjouslaskenta-aikaa annetaan noin kolme kuukautta.,

description: Afin de répondre aux exigences croissantes et aux besoins en espace, la commune de Regensdorf prévoit la construction d'un nouveau complexe scolaire pour l'école primaire. Le programme d'aménagement de l'école et des structures d'accueil périscolaire couvre environ 14 000 m² de surface utile. title: STEP Thurau, équipements pour la production de gaz
description:
Les stations d’épuration (STEP) de Wil, Jonschwil, Zuzwil et Uzwil seront mises hors service. Une nouvelle STEP, dénommée Thurau, sera construite sur le site de l’actuelle STEP d’Uzwil, à Niederuzwil. La nouvelle installation sera dimensionnée pour une capacité de traitement de 130’000 équivalents-habitants (EH).

Le présent appel d’offres porte sur les trois agitateurs centraux des digesteurs et des réservoirs de stockage des boues, chacun équipé d’un dôme de gaz, d’une chicane, de pièges à mousse ainsi que des conduites et de la robinetterie nécessaires, pour l’étape Ouest de la nouvelle STEP Thurau.

title: STEP Thurau, station de chargement de bennes, y compris les bennes et les rails de guidage
description:
Les stations d’épuration (STEP) de Wil, Jonschwil, Zuzwil et Uzwil seront mises hors service. Une nouvelle STEP, dénommée Thurau, sera construite sur le site de l’actuelle STEP d’Uzwil, à Niederuzwil. La nouvelle installation sera dimensionnée pour une capacité de traitement de 130’000 équivalents-habitants (EH).

Le présent appel d’offres porte sur les équipements de convoyage en contact avec les boues ainsi que sur les équipements mécaniques de la station de chargement des bennes pour l’étape Ouest de la nouvelle STEP Thurau.

Les prestations comprennent notamment la vis de convoyage principale en sortie de décanteur centrifuge, les vis de répartition destinées au chargement des bennes, les organes de fermeture pneumatiques, les capots de couverture avec système intégré de ventilation par aspiration, ainsi que les dispositifs de basculement des bennes à commande pneumatique et les rails de guidage au sol.

Les prestations requises comprennent l’étude et le dimensionnement complets des équipements sur le plan des procédés, leur fabrication en usine, leur livraison franco chantier, leur montage prêt à fonctionner, leur protection anticorrosion ainsi que leur mise en service réussie, comprenant les essais à sec et en eau, conformément aux documents du dossier d’appel d’offres.

title: ARA Thurau, Aufzüge, BKP 261
description:
Die Abwasserreinigungsanlagen (ARA) in Wil, Jonschwil, Zuzwil und Uzwil werden aufgehoben und es wird eine neue ARA auf dem Standort der ARA Uzwil in Niederuzwil gebaut. Die neue Anlage wird auf 130'000 Einwohner dimensioniert. Die vorliegende Ausschreibung umfasst die Erstellung und Inbetriebnahme von zwei Aufzugsanlagen:


In den Gebäuden «Faulung» und «Technik Biologie» sollen zwei neue Aufzüge installiert werden. Die Aufzüge werden primär zum Transport von Waren (IBC-Gebinde, Pumpen, Armaturen, Be-

triebsmittel, Ersatzteile etc.) genutzt. Der Aufzug im Gebäude Technik Biologie soll eine Nutzlast von 5'000 kg aufweisen und problemlos mit einem handelsüblichen Gabelstapler befahrbar sein.  

Der Aufzug im Gebäude Faulung soll eine Nutzlast von mind. 1'500 kg aufweisen und mindestens mit Hubwagen gut befahrbar sein. Optional ist der Mehrpreis für einen Aufzug mit 2'000 kg Nutzlast, mit möglichst den gleichen Schachtabmessungen anzubieten. Falls die gleichen Schachtabmessungen nicht möglich sind, so sind die notwendigen Schachtabmessungen zwingend anzugeben.

title: ARA Thurau, Phosphatfällung
description: Die Abwasserreinigungsanlagen (ARA) in Wil, Jonschwil, Zuzwil und Uzwil werden aufgehoben und es wird die neue ARA Thurau auf dem Standort der ARA Uzwil in Niederuzwil gebaut. Die neue Anlage wird auf 130'000 Einwohner dimensioniert. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Submission ist die vollständige Lieferung, Montage, Prüfung, Inbetriebsetzung und Dokumentation der Fällmittelanlage für die neue ARA Thurau. Die Anlage umfasst die Befüllstation, zwei Lagertanks für Eisen(III)-chlorid, einen Lagertank für Aluminiumsulfat, die Dosierstation mit Vor-, Simultan- und Reserve-Dosierpumpen sowie sämtliche loszugehörigen Rohrleitungen, Armaturen, Mess-, Überwachungs- und Sicherheitseinrichtungen.

title: Utskifting av vinduer og fasadearbeider ved Kvæfjordheimen
description: Bakgrunn Kvæfjord kommune skal gjennomføre planlagt vedlikehold og teknisk oppgradering ved Kvæfjordheimen. Eksisterende vinduer er utslitte og har behov for utskifting for å sikre byggets funksjon, redusere varmetap og begrense uønsket solbelastning i beboerrom og fellesarealer. Tiltaket skal bidra til bedre inneklima, mindre trekk og mer robuste bygningsdeler med lavt vedlikeholdsbehov. Samtidig skal fasaden oppgraderes i tilknytning til vindusutskiftingen, slik at bygget får en helhetlig og varig løsning. Kvæfjordheimen er et bygg i drift med pleietrengende beboere. Det er derfor viktig at arbeidene planlegges og gjennomføres på en trygg og hensynsfull måte, med særlig oppmerksomhet på å skjerme beboere og opprettholde forsvarlig drift under utførelsen. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en utførelsesentreprise for utskifting av om lag 89 vinduer ved Kvæfjordheimen, samt tilhørende fasadearbeider. Leveransen omfatter komplett levering og montering av nye vinduer tilpasset prosjektets behov, herunder vinduer med solreduserende egenskaper og vinduer med nødvendige brannkrav der dette er relevant. Oppdraget omfatter også nødvendige arbeider knyttet til demontering av eksisterende vinduer, miljøsanering og forsvarlig håndtering av PCB-holdige ruter med tilhørende dokumentasjon, samt riving og tilbakeføring av berørte bygningsdeler. Videre inngår isolering, tetting, beslag rundt åpninger, innvendig utforing, listing og malermessig utbedring for å sikre en komplett ferdigstillelse. I tillegg omfatter leveransen fasadearbeider i tilknytning til vindusutskiftingen, herunder montering av fasadeplater på brystninger. Entreprenøren skal også utføre kontrollmål før bestilling og levere komplett digital FDV-dokumentasjon ved avslutning av prosjektet. Arbeidene skal gjennomføres i et bygg som er i ordinær drift. Entreprenøren må derfor legge opp gjennomføringen slik at sikkerhet, fremdrift og hensynet til beboerne ivaretas på en god måte gjennom hele byggeperioden.

title: Kjøp av renseanlegg til BIR Ressurs - Mjelstad deponi
description: BIR AS på vegne av BIR Ressurs avd. Mjelstad (omtalt som BIR) skal i forbindelse med utvidelse av deponiet anskaffe et nytt renseanlegg for sigevann som oppstår som følge av nedbør på deponiet. BIR skal selv sikre at areal og bygg etableres der renseanlegget skal bygges. Leverandør av renseanlegget må selv stå for komplett leveranse av renseanlegg med alt tilhørende utstyr som er nødvendig for drift, samt montering, idriftsettelse og opplæring. Dette er videre beskrevet senere i konkurransegrunnlaget. Det er viktig for BIR å få tilstrekkelig informasjon om renseanlegget for å tilrettelegge for riktig dimensjonert bygg. BIR skal selv anskaffe pumpene som skal levere sigevann inn til renseanlegget og fra pumpesump etter renseanlegget til resipient. Det er viktig at BIR mottar informasjon om grensesnittet, og legger dimensjonene på renseanlegget til grunn for pumpekapasitet.

title: Request for Information (RFI) on Accessible Digital Technologies including Artificial Intelligence Systems
description: To support the development of the next phase of regulations, Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) is launching this RFI to gather information from digital technology vendors and suppliers on their current accessibility-related capabilities, practices, implementation challenges, and readiness with respect to artificial intelligence (AI) systems, software, and hardware. The RFI seeks information on: • Current accessibility capabilities, policies, and practices relating to software, hardware, and AI systems; • Conformance with relevant accessibility standards and specifications for software, hardware, and AI systems; • Approaches to incorporating accessibility throughout the product lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and procurement; • Barriers, implementation challenges, and considerations associated with achieving accessibility; and, • Organizational readiness to meet potential future accessibility requirements. The information collected through this process will help inform the development of the next phase of Digital Technologies Accessibility Regulations under the ACA.

title: Architectural-Engineering Services for Hazardous, Toxic, and Radioactive Waste Services for Various Locations within the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers New England District Mission Boundaries and Other North Atlantic Division Mission Boundaries
description: Contracts for a new HTRW MATOC pool are anticipated to be awarded to a minimum of three small contracts and up to three unrestricted contracts with a total value of up to $49,000,000.00. The location of the work to be performed under this contract shall be primarily in the six New England states but will also include other states and districts within the North Atlantic Division mission area. The work may involve performing Site Inspections, Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Proposed Plans, Records of Decision, Engineering Evaluation and Cost Analysis, Remedial Designs, Removal Designs, Removal Actions, Interim Removal Actions, and/or Remedial Actions at HTRW sites that are being addressed through the U.S Environmental Protection Agency (USEPAs) Superfund Program, the Department of Defense (DoDs) Base Realignment and Closure Program (BRAC) and Defense Environmental Restoration Program (DERP) Formerly Used Defense Sites (FUDS) Program, and other Interagency Support Customers. HTRW work performed for USACE must generally comply with the DERP statute [10 United States Code (USC) 2700 et seq.], the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA) 42 USC 9601 et seq., Executive Orders (EOs) 12580 and 13016, the National Oil and Hazardous Substances Pollution Contingency Plan (NCP), and all applicable DoD and Army policies.

description: The United States Department of Energy (the �Government� or �DOE�) is committed to maintaining and enhancing American leadership in Super Intelligence (SI) and energy generation to promote economic competitiveness, national security, and scientific advancement. Several Executive Orders (EO) (e.g., EOs 14154, 14179, 14277, and 14318) have been issued to support streamlining permitting of such infrastructure and accelerate project development, including directing agencies to leverage federal assets in support of these objectives. Advanced computing infrastructure is critical for SI training, scientific research, and various essential services, while energy generation is critical for protecting the United States� (U.S.) economic and national security and military preparedness by ensuring that an abundant supply of reliable energy is readily accessible. DOE is also committed to reducing U.S. dependence on foreign sources of critical minerals and strengthening national security and defense industrial capabilities by ensuring a stable, predictable, and affordable supply of minerals for domestic scientific, manufacturing, and energy needs. EO 14272, Ensuring National Security and Economic Resilience through Critical Minerals, highlights the strategic importance of critical minerals and directs measures to secure domestic sources of these processed minerals DOE is issuing this Request for Offer (RFO) to solicit offers from entities interested in entering into a long-term realty agreement (i.e., easement, lease) covering all or a portion of identified real property (the �Property�) located at the Hanford Site in Washington State. Statutory authority for this program includes but is not limited to: The Atomic Energy Act of 1954, 42 USC 2011, et seq., as amended, authorizes DOE to grant leases or easements to non-federal entities for the use of real property. title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Romosozumab, ATC M05BX06 für die Zeit 01.04.2025 - 31.03.2027
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff, Romosozumab, ATC M05BX06, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.04.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.03.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

Wirkstoff Guselkumab (ausschließlich Wirkstärke 100mg), ATC L04AC16, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.12.2026 in Kraft und endet am 31.03.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: Senior Procurement Executive Message to the Department of State Contractor and Financial Assistance Community on the Lapse in Appropriations
description: Senior Procurement Executive Message to the Department of State Contractor and Financial Assistance Community on the Lapse in Appropriations As the Department�s Senior Procurement Executive, I am reaching out to share guidance due to the lapse in appropriations that occurred on January 31, 2026. This guidance relates to the handling of Department contract and federal assistance (grants) awards that is consistent with Department and Office of Management and Budget�s Guidance on Operations During a Lapse in Appropriations. The Antideficiency Act prohibits agencies from incurring obligations that are in advance of, or that exceed, an appropriation, with certain limited exceptions. As you are aware, a full fiscal year 2026 appropriation is not yet enacted for the Department of State. For many Department accounts, this results in a lapse in funds designated to purchase certain supplies and services and issue grants and reduces the Department�s capacity to provide oversight on contracts and grants. As a result, certain planned procurements and grants may be cancelled, or postponed, and certain existing contracts and grants may be stopped, suspended, reduced in scope, or terminated. Additionally, payments may be delayed. If the lapse directly affects a contract or grant, on or about January 31, 2026, the Department�s contracting officers and grant officers will notify contractors and grantees of the status of their contract or grant. If a contract or grant will not be affected at the onset of the lapse in appropriations, the Department does not plan to provide any separate notifications or communications of that fact. Unless the contracting officer or grants officer provides a formal notification to the contrary, all Department contractors and grantees must continue to comply with all terms, conditions, requirements and deliveries specified in their contracts or grants. Once an extension to the Continuing Resolution or full-year appropriation is signed into law, the Department will begin implementing the plan to orderly resume activity and will notify contractors at that time. Thank you for your continued partnership with the Department, and for your cooperation as we work together to manage this lapse in appropriations.

title: Residential Apartment Condition Inspection and Reporting Services � U.S. Embassy Singapore
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Singapore intends to release the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it becomes available. The U.S. Embassy Singapore intends to issue a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for independent residential apartment condition inspection and reporting services at Embassy-leased residential properties in Singapore. The Government anticipates awarding an Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract under which services will be ordered through individual task orders on an as-needed basis. Services are anticipated to include comprehensive visual and functional inspections of residential apartments following landlord rectification and renovation works; identification and documentation of defects and deficiencies; high-resolution photographic records; and preparation of detailed condition reports. The anticipated contract performance period is one year, with no option periods. The Government may award the contract based on the initial quotation without conducting discussions. Contractors shall comply with the System for Award Management (SAM) registration requirements applicable to this acquisition, as specified in the solicitation and FAR 52.204-7. Contractors shall obtain all licenses, permits, registrations, and authorizations required to perform work in Singapore in accordance with DOSAR 652.242-73, Authorization and Performance. Offerors are advised that contract performance in Singapore may subject the contractor and/or its subcontractors to applicable Singapore laws and regulations, including business registration, employment, labor, and tax requirements. The U.S. Government will not assist contractors in obtaining local approvals or resolving host country compliance matters. Offerors are encouraged to independently assess all local legal, regulatory, and tax obligations prior to submitting a quotation. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered by the agency.

description: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA) Management & Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking an Expression of Interest (EOI) from qualified vendors to provide replacement services for the Air Handling Unit (AHU) at TAN-677. This initiative supports BEA�s commitment to maintaining efficient HVAC systems and ensuring compliance with facility performance standards. BACKGROUND The TAN-677 facility requires replacement of an aging AHU to improve reliability, energy efficiency, and operational safety. The scope of work may include the following: Removal and disposal of an HVAC and control system for building TAN-677. Installation of a new HVAC and control system and associated components for building TAN-677. Integration with existing ductwork, electrical, and control systems. title: Lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet palveluineen 2021-2025 (DPS)
description: Lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet palveluineen 2021-2025 (DPS) Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (jäljempänä myös "DPS") kohteena on lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet, sekä niihin liittyvien palveluiden toimittaminen Hansel Oy:n (jäljempänä Hansel) asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä 1 "DPS:n kohde". DPS:n kohteena ovat lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet, sekä niihin liittyvien palveluiden toimittaminen. DPS:llä voi hankkia seuraavia tuotteita: • Elektromekaaniset lukitusjärjestelmät; • Mekaaniset lukitusjärjestelmät; • Lukituskomponentit; • Edellä mainittuihin lukitusjärjestelmiin ja laitteisiin kiinteästi liittyvät ja niiden käyttötarkoitusta palvelevat lisälaitteet ja -tarvikkeet. DPS:n kohteena olevat tuotteisiin liittyvät palvelut ovat seuraavat: • Konsultointi- ja suunnittelupalvelu; • Asennuspalvelut; • Dokumentointipalvelut; • Takuuhuolto; • Korjaushuoltopalvelu; • Ennakkohuoltopalvelu; • Käyttökoulutus ja lisäkoulutus; • Elektromekaanisen lukitusjärjestelmän pääkäyttäjäpalvelut; ja • Avainten säilytyspalvelu ja avainten hallintapalvelu. DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. DPS on voimassa 31.1.2027 saakka, ellei sitä keskeytetä aikaisemmin. Hansel Oy:n asiakkaat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen 1.2.2021, ellei perustamisvaiheen pidennyksestä muuta johdu, ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä 31.1.2027. Hanselilla on oikeus keskeyttää dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä kesken sen voimassaolon. Hankintasopimukset tulee tehdä ennen dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän päättymistä. Hankintasopimukset voivat olla voimassa enintään 31.1.2027 saakka. Hankintasopimukseen perustuvia hankintoja (tilauksia) voidaan tehdä ennen hankintasopimuksen päättymistä. Tilauksiin perustuvat toimitukset tulee toimittaa viimeistään kuuden (6) kuukauden kuluessa hankintasopimuksen päättymisestä. Hankintasopimus voi kuitenkin olla voimassa enintään 31.1.2035 saakka siltä osin kuin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena oleviin tuotteisiin hankitaan tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena olevia palveluita, kuten lukitusjärjestelmän korjaushuoltopalveluita tai ennakkohuoltopalveluita. Tässä kohdassa tarkoitettujen palveluiden tuottamisesta tulee tehdä hankintasopimus ennen dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän päättymistä. DPS:N LAAJUUS Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on enintään 20 500 000 euroa (ilman arvonlisäveroa). Luku on sitoumukseton arvio.,

Der Vertragsschluss erfolgt im Rahmen des Open-House-Verfahrens: Individuelle Verhandlungen über Vertragsinhalte werden nicht geführt, es gelten einheitliche Konditionen. Die Krankenkassen sichern einzelnen Vertragspartnern keine Exklusivität zu. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt grundsätzlich maximal 24 Monate beginnend frühestens mit dem 01.02.2025 (ggf. abweichende Startzeiten ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los). Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 31.01.2027 (evtl. Ausnahmen ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los), unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. description: De viktigste punktene DFØ ønsker å oppnå på lang sikt er: - Sammenhengende tjenester og best mulig kundeopplevelse - Etablere et standardisert integrasjonslag som sikrer sømløs informasjonsflyt mellom kundenes fagsystemer og DFØs regnskapsløsning - Etablere en robust og skalerbar arkitektur som forenkler fremtidig forvaltning og vedlikehold av integrasjonsløsningene Målet med integrasjonslaget er å sikre en standardisert, sikker og skalerbar informasjonsflyt. Vi skal nå i gang med en dedikert designfase for å legge de arkitektoniske og tekniske rammene før selve utviklingen og implementeringen starter. Til å bidra inn i dette arbeidet søker vi erfarne konsulenter med spisskompetanse innen integrasjonsarkitektur. Oppgavene organiseres og prioriteres fortløpende innenfor utviklingsløpet. Arbeidet koordineres med DFØs utviklingsmiljø og følger etablerte arbeidsprosesser (herunder sprintbasert metodikk).

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss nicht exkl. Arzneimittel-Rabattvereinb. nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V im Wege eines Open-House-Modells zum Wirkstoff Ambrisentan (ATC-Code nach WHO: C02KX02)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss nicht exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über Arzneimittel mit dem Wirkstoff Ambrisentan (ATC-Code nach WHO: C02KX02). Der Vertragsabschluss erfolgt im Rahmen eines sog. Open-House-Modells, d. h. ein Vertragsabschluss steht innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen offen, sofern diese die Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und akzeptieren. Dies hat zur Folge, dass individuelle Vertragsverhandlungen nicht geführt werden und eine (Liefer-)Exklusivität nicht gegeben ist. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die Abnahmemenge unbekannt ist, da diese von der Nachfrage und der Entwicklung der Versichertenzahl, von dem Verordnungsverhalten der Ärzte sowie dem Abgabe- und Bevorratungsverhalten der öffentlichen Apotheken abhängig ist. title: YRBM-25 Dry-Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA) and Vessel Transportation
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS NOTICE IS ISSUED FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND ACQUISITION PLANNING PURPOSES AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION, REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, REQUEST FOR QUOTATION OR COMMITTMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT. 1. PURPOSE NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (FLCY), Site Marianas, is conducting market research to identify qualified and capable sources with the facilities, technical expertise, resources and transportation capability necessary to perform a comprehensive Dry-Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA) for YRBM-25, a non-self-propelled Repair, Berthing and Messing Barge currently located in Apra Harbor Guam. 2. GENERAL SCOPE OF REQUIREMENT The anticipated DSRA is expected to have an approximate duration of six (6) to eight (8) months. The contractor will be responsible for providing necessary management, planning, supervision, labor, engineering, facilities, dry-docking capability, equipment, materials, transportation, quality control and other resources required to accomplish the availability. The anticipated work includes, but is not limited to: Dry-docking and undocking of YrBM-25; Extensive underwater hull inspection, maintenance, repair and preservation; Identification and repair of structural deficiencies discovered during the availability; Significant structural steel repairs and renewals; inspection, repair and preservation of internal voids and tanks; Inspection, repair, renewals and preservation of associated piping and systems; Surface preparation and preservation necessary to support structural repairs and renewal; Inspection and testing associated with completed repairs; Performance of related systems work necessary to support structural and preservations efforts; Management and accomplishment of emergent or growth work identified during the availability; and Other maintenance and repair work necessary to accomplish the DSRA requirements. The final scope of work, work-item requirements, specifications, inspection requirements and acceptance criteria will be established in any resulting solicitation. 3. VESSEL TRANSPORTATION YRBM-25 is a non-self-propelled vessel. Accordingly, the contemplated requirement includes responsibility for the planning, coordination, management and execution of vessel transportation. The contractor will be responsible for transporting YRBM-25 from its homeport in Apra harbor, Guam, to the contractor�s proposed dry-docking and repair facility. Following completion and Government acceptance of the DSRA, the contractor will also be responsible for transporting YRBM-25 from the contractor�s facility to a Government-designated port in the Pacific located within a 1,500 nautical mile radius of Apra Harbor Guam. Interested sources should identify their proposed method of transportation, such as ocean tow, heavy-lift or another technically viable method, and describe, in detail, their capability to successfully plan, coordinate and execute the transportation. 4. INFORMATION REQUESTED Interested sources should submit information for the Government to assess their ability to successfully accomplish the complete requirement, including transportation, dry-docking, repair, preservation, structural work and return transportation. At a minimum, responses should address: Company name, physical address, UEI, CAGE Code and primary point of contact. Business size and applicable socio-economic status under the anticipated NAICS code. Proposed repair facility, including Facility name and location; Approximate nautical-mile distance from Apra Harbor, Guam; Dry-dock type and capacity; Maximum vessel dimensions and displacement that can be accommodated; Pier and berthing capabilities; Industrial services and utilities; and Other facility capabilities relevant to accomplishing the anticipated DSRA. Relevant experience successfully accomplishing comparable dry-docking availabilities, particularly those involving: Non-self-propelled vessels or barges; Extensive underwater hull preservation; Significant structural steel repair and renewal; Tank and void preservation; Associated piping and systems work; and Other facility capabilities relevant to accomplishing the anticipated DSRA. Transportation capability, including: Proposed method for transporting YRBM-25 from Apra harbor to the proposed facility Whether transportation would be self-performed, subcontracted, or accomplished through a teaming arrangement; Experience transporting comparable non-self-propelled vessels; Anticipated transportation lead time; and Significant permitting, regulatory, customs, international or logistical considerations associated with the proposed transportation approach The respondent�s ability to support an anticipated six- to eight-month DSRA, including facility availability and any anticipated scheduling or capacity constraints. Capability to manage and execute growth and emergent work that may be identified after dry-docking, inspection, opening of tanks or voids, or commencement of structural work. Identification of any Government-furnished information, property, services or other support the respondent believes would be necessary to successfully accomplish the requirement. Any significant technical, schedule, transportation, regulatory or acquisition risks the Government should consider in developing the requirement. Recommendations regarding the contemplated acquisition approach or requirement that could enhance competition, reduce schedule or performance risk or improve successful execution. 5. MARKET RESEARCH The Government is especially seeking information regarding the number and capability of sources that possess or can obtain through appropriate teaming or subcontracting arrangements, the combination of: Suitable docking facilities; (2) ship-repair capability necessary to accomplish a DSRA of this magnitude; (3) significant structural steel and preservation capability; and (4) the ability to successfully transport YRBM-25 from Guam to the proposed facility and return the vessel following completion of the availability. Responses that merely state that the respondent is capable of performing the requirement without providing sufficient information regarding he proposed facility, relevant experience and transportation WILL NOT provide sufficient information for the Government to assess capability. 6. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS: Interested parties shall submit responses electronically to the POCs listed within this sources sought notice not later than 31 January 2027 at 1200 ChST. Responses should not exceed 20 pages, excluding supporting facility information or standard company literature. The subject should state: �Sources Sought Response � YRBM-25 DSRA and Transportation� The Government may contact respondents for clarification or additional information as part of its market research. 7. DISCLAIMER This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research and acquisition planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or make an award. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting responses for costs incurred in preparing or submitting response to this notice. Information received may be used in developing the Government�s acquisition strategy, requirements, specifications, independent Government cost estimate and any future solicitation. Participation in this market research is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participation in any future acquisition.

All changes are flagged in the left margin of the modified document. The document is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that the slideshow used during the webinar held on October 8, 2026 is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that a list of Questions and Answers received during the webinar and by email is available under the "Bidding Details" tab. * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * NATIONAL SECURITY EXCEPTION In respect of all phases of the solicitation, SSC has invoked the National Security Exception (NSE). As such, this invocation exempts all phases of the procurement processes for sovereign cloud services from the application of all of Canada’s trade agreements, including the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (Article III(1)) and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Article 801). 1. INTRODUCTION The Government of Canada (GC) is advancing its digital infrastructure and hosting capabilities to meet evolving operational requirements and to deliver services to Canadians that are secure, reliable, and user-centric. Building on findings and industry feedback obtained through prior engagement activities, Shared Services Canada (SSC) is establishing a structured Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process as an initial step to support future procurements. The Sovereign Cloud Qualification process is intended to: • Establish a standing entry point for Canadian-owned and -controlled businesses seeking to qualify to participate in sovereign cloud procurements • Enable Canada to collect information on available and emerging offerings to support market awareness and procurement planning • Provide a consistent, transparent, and accessible mechanism for industry engagement • This Notice of Planned Procurement does not constitute a commitment by Canada to issue any solicitation or to procure any services. 2. PROCESS OVERVIEW The Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process is supported by an Invitation to Qualify (ITQ). The ITQ defines the requirements for qualification, including: • Eligibility conditions • Submission requirements • Supporting documentation • Process instructions The qualification process serves as the entry point and a mandatory step for vendors to participate in current and future sovereign cloud procurement processes. Vendors that participate in the qualification process and meet the eligibility conditions defined in the ITQ will be considered as Qualified Respondents (QR) for participation in future sovereign cloud procurement opportunities. This qualification process is not a competitive procurement process and will not result in a contract award. It is intended solely to establish a list of qualified vendors for participation in future procurement activities. 3. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS Eligibility conditions details are defined in the ITQ (available in tab “Bidding Details” above). At a minimum, eligibility conditions include: • Confirmation of Respondent’s Canadian ownership and control, including parent companies. • Submission of a Value Proposition describing the respondent’s sovereign cloud offerings. 4. OBJECTIVE AND SCOPE 4.1 Objective The objective of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream is to strengthen Canada’s cloud posture by enabling and supporting solutions that advance Canadian control over data and services, and protection from foreign legal or extraterritorial authority. The sovereign cloud procurement stream is intended to complement, and not replace, existing cloud procurement approaches. 4.2 Scope (Indicative Only) The service categories described below are indicative only and provided to inform respondents of the types of capabilities Canada may consider procuring in the future. Additional requirements, eligibility conditions, certifications, or evaluation criteria will be defined in future procurement stages once the procurement process is confirmed The scope of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream may include, but is not limited to: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): This category may include sovereign fundamental computing resources such as processing, storage, and networking. These services allow departments to deploy and run their own software, including operating systems and applications. While the cloud provider manages the underlying infrastructure, Canada retains control over operating systems, storage, deployed applications, and certain network configuration. Platform as a Service (PaaS): This category may include sovereign cloud services that allow departments to deploy and run applications built using programming languages, libraries, services, and tools supported by the provider. The provider manages the underlying infrastructure, including networks, servers, operating systems, and storage, while Canada retains control over the applications it deploys and the configuration of the application hosting environment. AI enabling services: This category may include sovereign services that support the development, deployment, or operation of artificial intelligence solutions, such as machine learning platforms, model hosting, data processing environments, and AI infrastructure. Managed Service Providers of Classified Cloud Solutions: This category may include managed services for classified cloud solutions. Vendors intending to operate as infrastructure providers will be required to provide certification from a recognized classified cloud solution provider in the Five Eyes confirming their authorization and agreement to deliver classified cloud services and associated managed solutions. Recognizing that many classified and unclassified cloud solutions are operated or owned by foreign providers, Canada may also consider managed service providers that have unique access to such cloud service solutions, even where those solutions are owned by foreign entities. In such cases, the managed service provider will need to demonstrate full control over the technology and the delivery of services. Other cloud or cloud enabling capabilities that support sovereign digital service delivery. This category may include other sovereign cloud or cloud-enabling capabilities not otherwise described in the indicative scopes provided above. 5. SUBMISSION PROCEDURES To participate in the Sovereign Cloud Qualification process, respondents must complete and submit the designated submission form in accordance with the requirements set out in the ITQ. 6. description: Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Port Hueneme Division (PHD) Code 027 � Simplified Acquisition Procedures (SAP) Code 027 provides Simplified Acquisition Procedures (SAP) contracting support in furtherance of NSWC PHD mission requirements for the following partner organizations: � Code 01 � Code 02 � Code 10 � Code C � Code D � Code E � Code N � Code BD � Code FR0 � Code W To assist industry partners with planning and market research, Code 027 is releasing the following acquisition forecast. This forecast will be updated throughout the fiscal year as requirements become known, with updates provided at least quarterly. The information contained herein is provided solely for planning and informational purposes and is intended to facilitate industry awareness of potential acquisition opportunities. This forecast does not constitute a specific offer, solicitation, or commitment by NSWC PHD to fund any requirement referenced, in whole or in part. All acquisitions remain subject to applicable statutory, regulatory, and funding considerations. This forecast includes anticipated contract actions that may exceed the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT) of $350,000 in accordance with FAR Part 13.5 procedures. The forecast is not all-inclusive but reflects the best information available at the time of publication. Live contract opportunities and more detailed information regarding individual requirements will be provided when actions are synopsized through the Governmentwide Point of Entry (GPE) or when solicitations are issued. Each anticipated acquisition identifies the responsible Requirements Generator (RG). Any statements regarding potential small business set-asides or other socioeconomic programs are strictly notional. Final determinations will be made at the time the acquisition is initiated. title: Facility Readiness and Maintenance Execution (FRAME) Request for Proposal (RFP) - DRAFT
description: This Special Notice provides interested parties with information regarding the availability of the draft Request for Proposal (dRFP), review requirements, the tentative acquisition schedule, and the upcoming Industry Day and Site Visit. This notice is for planning purposes only and does not constitute an invitation for bids, request for proposals, or quotes, nor does it indicate that the Government will contract for the items described herein. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with submitting feedback or attending the events outlined in this notice. The 30th Contracting Squadron (30 CONS/PKD) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB), CA, is requesting industry feedback on the dRFP for the Facility Readiness and Maintenance Execution (FRAME) contract. FRAME is the follow-on acquisition to the current Launch Operations Support Contract (LOSC) (Contract #FA4610-23-D-0001, currently performed by Call Henry, Inc.). FRAME follow-on acquisition is 100% Small Business Set-Aside. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort is 561210 Facilities Support Services (small business size standard is $47M). Description of Services, Background, and Objective: FRAME is a non-personal services contract that provides maintenance, repair, modification, and modernization for?over 130?facilities, property, and equipment (P&E)?supporting?the nation�s space mission, defense, and test activities at VSFB and its associated geographically-separated locations. The scope of work involves facility infrastructure and systems (including water and gas mains, roads, generators, power distribution, HVAC, waste systems, and roofing) alongside the execution of distinct sustainment projects and?standby support for urgent repairs during select?launch operations to ensure maximum operational readiness. Additionally, the contract encompasses the inspection,?testing,?and certification of all Space Launch Delta 30 cranes and elevators. A key change under this follow-on acquisition is that the South Vandenberg Power Plant (SVPP) is no longer a requirement and will not be carried over from the legacy LOSC to the new FRAME contract. The primary objective of the FRAME contract is to ensure Real Property Installed Equipment (RPIE) and facilities are maintained and operationally ready for a variety of ballistic missile, space, guided weapon, and aircraft test and evaluation missions in support of Space Launch Delta 30 (SLD 30), 30th Civil Engineer Squadron (30 CES), 4th Launch Squadron (4 LS), 2nd Range Operations Squadron (2 ROPS), Missile Defense Agency (MDA), U. S. Space Forces - Space (S4S), 18th Space Defense Squadron (18 SDS), Sentinel, 30th Operations Support Squadron (30 OSS), 2nd Space Launch Squadron (2 SLS), the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), and various other Range Users. Mission Essential Services: The FRAME contract contains some mission-essential requirements which require continued support during peacetime, national emergency, and/or wartime scenarios. Tentative Acquisition Schedule: dRFP Release: 8 Sep 26 Final RFP Issuance: Jan 27 Proposals Due: Mar 27 Anticipated Award: 18 Dec 27 Performance Start:?1 Apr 28 4. Industry Day and Site Visit Event Details Interested businesses are invited to register for the upcoming two-day event. Representatives will have the opportunity to attend a briefing detailing the contract structure, tour key range facilities, and participate in one-on-one sessions with the Government program team. Dates: September 22, 2026 (General Briefing & Tour) � September 23, 2026 (One-on-One Sessions) Location: Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB), CA Maximum Attendees: Limited to two (2) representatives per prospective company due to base logistical constraints. Registration and RSVP Deadlines: Attendee RSVP & Security Vetting Submission: No later than Friday, September 11, 2026, at 16:30 Pacific Time. Provide your full name and company. Late requests may not be processed. One-on-One Meeting Request: Companies interested in booking a one-on-one session with the program office must explicitly request it via email by Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 16:30 Pacific Time. Slots are limited and will be scheduled on a first-come, first-served basis. Maps and a tentative agenda are attached to this announcement to assist registered attendees with navigation and scheduling. Base Access & Entry Requirements: All site visit attendees must report to the Vandenberg Visitor Control Center (VCC), located at 6 California Blvd (Santa Maria Gate) prior to entry (VCC hours: 0600-1800). Arrive Early: Attendees are strongly encouraged to arrive early to the Visitor Control Center to allow sufficient time for base entry processing and to avoid delays getting to the briefing. Identification for Non-CAC Holders: Attendees who do not possess a Common Access Card (CAC) must present a REAL ID-compliant credential or a valid U.S. Passport. If an attendee does not have a REAL ID or a Passport, they must bring and present a standard state-issued Driver's License or ID card, a Birth Certificate, and a physical Social Security Card to obtain a base visitor pass. Foreign Nationals will not be able to participate due to the time necessary to vet access. 5. Important Site Visit Disclaimers & Rules of Conduct: Change of Solicitation Terms: Please understand that nothing said during the Industry Day briefings, site tours, or one-on-one sessions by any Government representative changes the terms, conditions, specifications, or requirements of the solicitation. If a change to the solicitation is determined to be necessary based on what is discussed or observed, it will be formally issued as a written amendment via email. Photography and Video Restrictions: No photography or video recording is permitted on this installation at any time, unless specific, designated areas are explicitly pointed out and authorized by the hosting Facility Manager. 6. Submission of Questions & Comments (CRM) The Government is actively seeking industry feedback on the Draft PWS and planned acquisition strategy to ensure clear, high-performing requirements. To submit questions or comments concerning the acquisition and dRFP, prospective offerors must use the official Comment Resolution Matrix (CRM) Excel spreadsheet (which will be posted with the Draft RFP documents). Completed CRM spreadsheets must be returned to the Points of Contact listed below. The deadline for submitting dRFP and Industry Day comments is September 29, 2026, by 16:30 Pacific Time. 7. Primary Points of Contact For all RSVP submissions, one-on-one requests, CRM question submittals or administrative questions, please send correspondence via email to BOTH of the following representatives: Primary POC (Contracting Officer): Katherine Williams, 30 CONS/PKD Email: katherine.williams.9@spaceforce.mil Secondary POC (Contract Specialist): Sabrina Swain, 30 CONS/PKD Email: sabrina.swain.1@spaceforce.mil 9/8/2026: This office is updating this draft RFP to update and add additional attachments. 9/29/2026: This office is updating the tentative acquisition schedule and extending the date of this draft RFP. 10/8/2026: This office is adding the following attachments to this draft RFP: FRAME Industry Day Brief, FRAME Industry Day CRM 20261008, and FRAME RFP_GFP List_07Oct2026.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss nicht-exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V (Open-House-Modell)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss von Vereinbarungen nach § 130 a Abs. 8 SGB V zu Fertigarzneimitteln mit verschiedenen Wirkstoffen bzw. Wirkstoffkombinationen im Rahmen eines sogenannten „Open-House-Modells“. Der Beitritt bzw. der Vertragsabschluss kann jederzeit und zu den gleichen Bedingungen erfolgen. title: Sources Sought - Hawaii-Wide Forklift Lease BPA
description: Regional Contracting Office Hawaii (RCO-HI) is conducting market research to identify capable commercial sources that can provide rental or dry lease Material Handling Equipment (MHE), including forklifts and container-handling equipment, in support of Government requirements throughout the Hawaiian Islands. This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for quotation, request for proposal, commitment, or obligation by the Government. The Government does not intend to award a contract or Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) as a result of responses to this notice, nor will the Government reimburse any costs associated with preparing a response.RCO-HI anticipates a potential requirement to establish multiple BPAs with qualified vendors to provide MHE rental/dry lease support. Requirements may arise with limited advance notice and may require equipment delivery, pickup, maintenance, repair, replacement equipment, and field-service support. The anticipated areas of performance include Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai. Interested vendors may respond if they are capable of supporting one or more of these islands; vendors are not required to demonstrate capability across all locations.The Government is seeking information regarding the commercial availability of approximately 5,000-pound capacity forklifts; approximately 6,000-pound capacity narrow-aisle or warehouse-configured forklifts; approximately 6,000-pound capacity standard industrial forklifts; approximately 10,000-pound capacity industrial, rough-terrain, or telehandler-type forklifts; approximately 30,000-pound capacity heavy-lift forklifts; and Rough Terrain Container Handlers (RTCHs) or commercially comparable container-handling equipment. Equipment may be required for warehouse, installation, field, port, airfield, cargo-handling, and mobilization support activities. For each type of equipment offered, vendors should identify the manufacturer, model, model year, rated lift capacity, lift height, mast configuration, fork length, overall dimensions, operating weight, tire type, fuel or power type, available attachments, and any significant operating limitations. Vendors should also identify whether equipment is physically located on the island where it would be provided, available for transfer from another Hawaiian island, or would require shipment from outside Hawaii.The Government is particularly interested in understanding each vendor???s fleet availability and surge capacity. Interested vendors should identify the number of units in their total fleet for each equipment category, the number of units physically located on Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai, and the number of units normally available for short-notice rental. Vendors should state the maximum quantity of each equipment type that they could provide simultaneously for a single Government requirement and should distinguish between equipment available within seven days and equipment available within 30 days. Vendors should also explain whether equipment may be reserved, committed, or otherwise prioritized under a BPA and identify any associated reservation fees, minimum-use periods, cancellation terms, or other commercial conditions.Interested vendors should describe their standard rental or dry lease terms, including the rental periods available and any minimum rental duration. Responses should explain which services are included in quoted rental rates and which services are separately priced. Vendors should describe their preventive-maintenance program, corrective-maintenance procedures, normal and emergency service response times, after-hours and weekend support, and process for providing replacement equipment when a unit becomes non-mission capable. Vendors should also identify any Government responsibilities associated with the rental, including operator qualifications, fuel, cleaning, equipment staging, access coordination, wash-rack use, damage liability, or return-condition requirements.Vendors should describe their delivery, pickup, transportation, and inter-island movement capabilities. Responses should identify normal delivery timelines and emergency delivery timelines after receipt of an order or BPA call, including the vendor???s ability to support 24-hour, 48-hour, 72-hour, five-day, and seven-day response requirements. Vendors should state whether they possess or can arrange heavy-haul transportation suitable for 30,000-pound forklifts, RTCHs, and other oversized or overweight MHE. Vendors should also identify whether they can move equipment between Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai; the anticipated transportation method; estimated transit time; and associated costs or constraints.The Government is also seeking information on vendor ability to deliver and service equipment at authorized commercial port facilities, airfields, Hawaii Department of Transportation facilities, military installations, and other controlled-access locations. Vendors should provide a general description of their current ability to access and service such locations, including any anticipated requirements for installation access, vehicle registration, personnel credentialing, safety documentation, insurance, escorts, delivery coordination, or lead time. Vendors should not submit sensitive credentials, security plans, or personally identifiable information in response to this notice.To assist the Government in developing an acquisition strategy and independent Government cost estimate, vendors should provide nonbinding budgetary pricing for each equipment category offered. Pricing information should include daily, weekly, and monthly rental rates; delivery and pickup charges; mobilization and demobilization charges; inter-island transportation charges; attachment costs; excess-hour charges; environmental or administrative fees; damage-waiver costs; emergency, after-hours, weekend, or holiday charges; and any other recurring or nonrecurring costs. Vendors should identify discounts available for multiple units, extended rental periods, recurring BPA calls, advance reservations, multiple-island support, or other volume-based arrangements. Vendors should also identify the anticipated duration for which proposed pricing could remain valid and describe any expected escalation factors.Interested vendors should provide company name, business address, website, primary point of contact, telephone number, email address, Unique Entity ID, CAGE code if applicable, and business size and socioeconomic status under the applicable North American Industry Classification System code. Vendors should identify whether they are the equipment owner, an authorized dealer, a broker, or a prime contractor using subcontracted equipment or maintenance support. If subcontractors, affiliates, or third-party equipment owners would be used, the vendor should identify their role and explain the respondent???s ability to control equipment availability, delivery, maintenance, and response times.The email subject line should state: ???Sources Sought Response ??? MHE Rental/Dry Lease Support ??? Hawaiian Islands ??? [Company Name].??? Responses should clearly identify the Hawaiian island or islands that the vendor can support and the types and quantities of equipment available at each location.This notice is for planning and market-research purposes only. It does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation, establish a BPA, award a contract, or pay for information received in response to this notice. The Government may use information received to refine the scope, determine the appropriate acquisition strategy, assess small-business capability, establish potential geographic groupings or line items, and develop future solicitation requirements.

title: IFK-26-01-NF Utbygging av bredbåndsinfrastruktur i Nord-Fron kommune
description: Formål Nord-Fron kommune har til hensikt å inngå avtale om utbygging av høykapasitetsbredbåndsinfrastruktur, gjennom å gi støtte til utbyggere. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å dekke oppdragsgivers behov for kostnadseffektivt høyhastighetsbredbånd for de angitte adresser i konkurransegrunnlaget og å sikre at flest mulig innbyggere og næringsdrivende skal få mulighet til å knytte seg til høyhastighetsbredbånd, der slike løsninger i dag ikke er tilgjengelige. Leverandøren skal bruke sin fagkunnskap og kompetanse for å bidra til at kontraktens formål blir ivaretatt. Omfang Omfanget av anskaffelsen skal dekke høyhastighetsbredbånd til de adresser som er oppgitt som husstander i vedlagt adressegrunnlag, i henhold til vedlagte kravspesifikasjon Oppdragsgiver har til hensikt å bygge bredbåndsinfrastruktur i området angitt i adresselisten og i fylkeskommunens kartløsning. Kart over området ligger i Innlandet fylkeskommunes kartverk. Følg linken nedenfor: https://geocortex3.innlandsgis.no/ifk/bredband/bredbandinnsyn.html Kommunen har bestemt at den enkelte husstanden skal ha en egenandel på kr. 10 000,- Kommunen tillegger utbygger å innhente denne egenandelen fra husstand, ved gjennomføring av salg. Tilbyder kan ved salg velge å dekke hele eller deler av husstandens egenandel, dersom dette er ønskelig. Tilbyder skal derfor ikke legge inn annen tilkoblingsavgift i sitt tilbud. For komplett oversikt over området som er del av anskaffelsen og tekniske krav, henvises det til vedlagte kravspesifikasjon og øvrige dokumenter med oversikt over områdene. Det kreves at 100% av oppgitte adresser dekkes av tilbudet, for å kunne ansees som et komplett tilbud. Dersom enkelte adresser viser seg svært fordyrende å bygge ut, vil dette bli et tema i forhandlinger. Tilbyder bes vise hvilke adresser som eventuelt er svært fordyrende og hva disse adressene koster. Terskel for gjennomføring av kontraktsarbeidene, vil være ved 65% «take-rate» ved salg. Dette skal hensynta eventuelle grossistsalg og ikke bare valgt leverandørs salg. Dette beregnes ut ifra adresselistene som oppdragsgiver har benyttet i konkurransegrunnlaget. For kontrakter som omfatter 10 eller færre husstander, er det ønskelig med dialog mellom oppdragsgiver og leverandør for å vurdere hva som skal til for å kunne gjennomføre utbyggingen dersom «take-rate» er under 65%. Oppdragsgivers adresselister har forrang over kartpolygon for området. Kontraktstype Det skal inngås avtale med én leverandør. Avtale vil være en tilpasset NS 8406 Forenklet norsk bygge- og anleggskontrakt, som tilpasses slik at det tas høyde for at utbygger også blir eier. De spesielle kontraktbestemmelser ligger vedlagt.
